description: ACRV1 pLDDT profile and TM-scores against experimental PDB structural homologs
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
pdbtxt=S.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-P26436-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=120).text
seq=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P26436.fasta",timeout=60).text.split('\n',1)[1].replace('\n','')
ca={};plddt={}
for L in pdbtxt.splitlines():
    if L.startswith('ATOM') and L[12:16].strip()=='CA':
        r=int(L[22:26]);ca[r]=(float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54]));plddt[r]=float(L[60:66])
dom=sorted(r for r in ca if 186<=r<=265);qca=np.array([ca[r] for r in dom]);LQ=80
cys=[i+186 for i,c in enumerate(seq[185:265]) if c=='C']

def kabsch(P,Q):
    Pm,Qm=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);Pc,Qc=P-Pm,Q-Qm
    V,_,Wt=np.linalg.svd(Pc.T@Qc);R=V@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))])@Wt
    return R,Qm-Pm@R
def tmscore(P,Q,Ln):
    d0=max(1.24*(Ln-15)**(1/3)-1.8,.5);n=len(P);best=0.
    for L0 in [n,max(4,n//2),max(4,n//4)]:
        for st in range(0,n-L0+1,max(1,L0)):
            idx=np.arange(st,st+L0)
            for _ in range(12):
                R,t=kabsch(P[idx],Q[idx]);dist=np.linalg.norm(P@R+t-Q,axis=1)
                best=max(best,np.sum(1/(1+(dist/d0)**2))/Ln);new=None
                for cut in (d0+1,d0+2,d0+3,8.):
                    c=np.where(dist<cut)[0]
                    if len(c)>=3: new=c;break
                if new is None or (len(new)==len(idx) and np.array_equal(new,idx)): break
                idx=new
    return best

fs=S.get("https://search.foldseek.com/api/result/yXBid0PUXggiyh_CgkcU8h_2_2K-7mKqCsythw/0",timeout=240).json()
rows=[]
for r in fs['results']:
    als=r['alignments'];als=als[0] if isinstance(als[0],list) else als
    for a in sorted(als,key=lambda a:a['eval'])[:45]:
        if not a.get('tCa'): continue
        arr=np.fromstring(a['tCa'],sep=',');T=arr.reshape(len(arr)//3,3)
        qi=a['qStartPos']-1;ti=a['dbStartPos']-1;pi=[];tj=[]
        for qc,tc in zip(a['qAln'],a['dbAln']):
            if qc!='-' and tc!='-':
                if qi<LQ and ti<len(T): pi.append(qi);tj.append(ti)
                qi+=1;ti+=1
            elif qc=='-': ti+=1
            else: qi+=1
        if len(pi)<20: continue
        rows.append(dict(db=r['db'],target=a['target'],evalue=a['eval'],seqId=a['seqId'],TM=tmscore(qca[pi],T[tj],LQ)))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("SANITY self-hit TM =",round(df.loc[df.target.str.contains('AF-P26436-F1-'),'TM'].max(),3))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,8.5),gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[1.2,1]})
ax=axes[0];rr=np.array(sorted(ca));p=np.array([plddt[i] for i in rr])
ax.fill_between(rr,0,p,where=p>=70,color='#2a6f97',alpha=.85,label='pLDDT $\\geq$ 70')
ax.fill_between(rr,0,p,where=p<70,color='#c9ced4',alpha=.9,label='pLDDT < 70')
ax.plot(rr,p,color='#22333b',lw=.8);ax.axhline(70,ls='--',c='#777',lw=.8)
ax.axvspan(1,21,color='#e9c46a',alpha=.35);ax.text(11,10,'signal\npeptide',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.axvspan(22,185,color='#f4a261',alpha=.18)
ax.text(103,10,'Ser/Glu-rich repeat region, residues 22-185\nmean pLDDT 44.6, 95% of residues below 50',ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.axvspan(186,265,color='#2a6f97',alpha=.14)
ax.text(226,10,'folded domain 186-265\nmean pLDDT 96.5',ha='center',fontsize=9,color='#14425e')
for c in cys: ax.plot(c,100,marker='v',ms=5,color='#bb3e03',clip_on=False)
ax.text(226,104,'10 cysteines, 5 predicted disulfides',ha='center',fontsize=8,color='#bb3e03')
ax.set_xlim(1,266);ax.set_ylim(0,100);ax.set_xlabel('residue in P26436 (ACRV1 / SP-10)')
ax.set_ylabel('AlphaFold pLDDT');ax.legend(loc='center left',fontsize=8,frameon=False)
ax.set_title('ACRV1 is one folded 80-residue domain on a long disordered stalk (AlphaFold DB v6)',fontsize=11)

ax=axes[1]
lab={'6oaz':'GPIHBP1 (bound to lipoprotein lipase)','6e7k':'GPIHBP1','4p7u':'TGFBR2 ectodomain','6mac':'ActRIIB ectodomain',
 '6gbi':'LU-domain Wnt-signalling protein','6zso':'LYPD6B LU domain','3laq':'uPAR (PLAUR)','1ks6':'TGFBR2 ectodomain',
 '3evs':'BMPR-IB ectodomain','3kfd':'TGFBR2 ectodomain','7e17':'uPAR, dimeric','2fd6':'uPAR','1ywh':'uPAR',
 '6ion':'C4.4A / LYPD3','6iom':'C4.4A / LYPD3','6aex':'uPAR, mouse','3hh7':'snake three-finger neurotoxin',
 '6wjc':'muscarinic toxin MT7','3era':'erabutoxin a','2h7z':'irditoxin','7bps':'TEX101','7z14':'alpha-neurotoxin'}
sub=df[df.db=='pdb100'].copy();sub['pdbid']=sub.target.str[:4];sub['name']=sub.pdbid.map(lab)
sub=sub.dropna(subset=['name']).sort_values('TM',ascending=False).drop_duplicates('name').head(14)
ax.barh(range(len(sub)),sub.TM,color=['#2a6f97' if t>=.5 else '#c9ced4' for t in sub.TM])
ax.set_yticks(range(len(sub)));ax.set_yticklabels([f"{n}  ({i})" for n,i in zip(sub.name,sub.pdbid)],fontsize=8.5)
ax.invert_yaxis();ax.axvline(.5,ls='--',c='#bb3e03',lw=1)
ax.text(.505,len(sub)-.4,'TM = 0.5, same-fold threshold',fontsize=8,color='#bb3e03')
ax.set_xlabel('TM-score, ACRV1 186-265 vs experimental structure (normalised by L = 80)');ax.set_xlim(0,.85)
ax.set_title('Every confident PDB structural homolog is a Ly6/uPAR (LU) three-finger protein',fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print(sub[['pdbid','name','TM','evalue','seqId']].to_string(index=False))
